FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_game_facts" g
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" d ON g.team_id = d.team_id
WHERE g.season = 2019 AND g.is_home = TRUE
GROUP BY d.arena
ORDER BY games_hosted DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What were LeBron James' points per game against the Boston Celtics across all seasons, counting every game in the data, preseason and playoffs included? Round to two decimals.
Against which team did Kevin Durant score the most total points across all seasons, counting every game in the data, preseason and playoffs included? Give the team abbreviation and the points.
sql:
SELECT d.team_id, d.team_abbreviation, SUM(p.points) AS total_points
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts" p
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" d
  ON p.opponent_team_id = d.team_id
WHERE LOWER(p.player_name) = 'kevin durant'
  AND p.participated = TRUE
GROUP BY d.team_id, d.team_abbreviation
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Which team scored the most total points in the 2021 season, counting every game in the data, preseason and playoffs included? Give the team abbreviation and the points.
sql:
SELECT t.team_id, d.team_abbreviation, SUM(t.total_points) AS total_points
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_season_facts" AS t
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" AS d
  ON d.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.season = 2021
GROUP BY t.team_id, d.team_abbreviation
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1
